nav.title: Pokapū Kōrero AI
nav.subtitle: Āwhina reo maha me te whakawhiti ki te tangata.

status.apiUnavailable: Takiuru / API kāore i te wātea

stats.providerQualificationNote: Ko ngā reo i whakamātauria motuhaketia ka tatauhia

customer.title: Tīmata he kōrero
customer.consentText: E whakaae ana ahau ka taea tēnei kōrero te tukatuka e te kaiwhakarato AI. Ka whakamunatia ngā tuhinga i mua i te rongoā.
customer.setupHint: Kāore e wātea kia whiria e te kaiwhakahaere te kī whakamuna me te kaiwhakarato AI.
customer.startHint: Hanga he wātū whakaae kia tīmata ai.
customer.chatEmpty: Ka puta ngā karere ki konei. Ko ngā mahi AI he whakaaro noa; kāore he utu, he huringa pūkete, he whakahoki moni rānei e mahia.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Ka tukuna te reo pūtiro ki te kaiwhakarato; kāore a OpsCore e kī ana ka rongoātia te reo taketake.
customer.voiceRequirement: Me HTTPS (rānei localhost), hopuoro, whakaaetanga, tauira Realtime me te kī kaiwhakarato mō te reo pūtiro. Ehara i te piriti waea PSTN/SIP.

queue.title: Rārangi whakawhiti
queue.description: Ka puta ngā kōrero mōrearea, kāore anō kia oti, kua tonoa rānei e te tangata ki konei. He tono te rārangi, ehara i te hononga.
queue.empty: Kāore he whakawhiti tāngata mō tēnei whakahaere.
queue.replyStorageNote: Ka whakamunatia ngā whakautu tāngata, ka kitea i te tuhinga kōrero.
queue.resolveNote: Kua whakatauria e te kaimahi kua tohua.

boundaries.title: Ngā rohe mahi
boundaries.automateBody: He whakautu tuatahi reo maha, he whakamārama, he arotake mōrearea, he rongoā tuhinga haumaru, he hanga rārangi me te tohu kaimahi.
boundaries.humanBody: He tono tangata, he iti te whakapono, he mōrearea nui, kāore he kaupapa here, he take kāore anō kia whakatau, he amuamu tūmataiti, he mahi kāore i te mōhiotia.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: Kāore e taea e tēnei pōkai anake
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, īmēra, piriti waea, CRM me te whakapūmau reo me whai kaiwhakarato tūturu, taipitopito me ngā whakamātautau.

handoffReasons.customer_requested_human: I tono te kaihoko i tētahi tangata

messages.qualificationNotice: Kāore he reo kua whakamanahia kia oti ngā whakamātautau tuhinga, ASR, TTS me te reo.
messages.configOk: Kua whiria. Me whakamātautau tonu te hononga kaiwhakarato me te kounga reo.
messages.conversationCreated: Kua hanga he kōrero haumaru. Kāore anō te kounga reo kia whakamanahia.
messages.handoffQueued: Kua tuu te whakawhiti tāngata ki te rārangi ({reason}). He tono tēnei, ehara i te hononga ora.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Kāore te whakautu AI i oti. Kāore he mahi i mahia. Ka taea e koe te tono tangata.
messages.apiUnavailable: Kāore i taea te API o te Pokapū Kōrero te uta. Takiuru ki te paewhiri OpsCore, kātahi whakahoutia tēnei whārangi.
messages.suggestedNextStep: He whakaaro noa mō te mahi e whai ake (kāore i mahia): {step}.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Kua tuu te whakawhiti tāngata ki te rārangi ({reason}). Kāore te rārangi e whakaatu he kaimahi e hono ana.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Kua tuu te whakawhiti tāngata ki te rārangi. E mutu ana te wātū AI; kāore te whakawhiti waea ora i te whiria.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: E tono ana i tētahi kī reo poto…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: I pūrongo te kaiwhakarato Realtime i tētahi hapa. Whakamutua te wātū reo, arotakea te whiria, kātahi whakamātauria anō.
messages.voiceActive: Kei te mahi te wātū reo. Pēhia “Request human” i ngā wā katoa; ka hanga he rārangi, ehara i te whakawhiti PSTN.
messages.queueUnavailable: Kāore te rārangi i te wātea: {reason}.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Me whakaae i mua i te tīmatanga o te kōrero.
errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: Kāore i taea te whakautu a te tūmau te pānui.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Kāore i taea te toro atu ki te kaiwhakarato reo Realtime.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Kāore tēnei pūtiro e tautoko ana i te reo Realtime.
errors.HANDOFF_NOT_CLAIMED: Kāore i taea te whakawhiti te manāki.
